Set-Location 'J:\inkubator'; $index='firmware\data\index.html'; $out='firmware\data\kalibracja.html'; $content=Get-Content $index; $start=$content.FindIndex({ $_ -like '*KALIBRACJA TACY*' }); $end=$content.FindIndex({ $_ -like 'const DAY_MS=86400000;*' }); if($start -lt 0 -or $end -lt 0){ Write-Error 'Markers not found'; exit 1 }; $end=$end-2; $block=$content[$start..$end]; Set-Content $out $block -NoNewline; $placeholder=@'
<!-- ═══════════════════════ KALIBRACJA TACY ═══════════════════════ -->
<div id="view-kalibracja-container" class="view main">
  <div class="kal-card" style="padding:32px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono);">
    Ładuję panel kalibracji…
  </div>
</div>

<script>
async function loadKalibracjaSection() {
  try {
    const resp = await fetch('kalibracja.html');
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(resp.status + ' ' + resp.statusText);
    const html = await resp.text();
    const container = document.getElementById('view-kalibracja-container');
    if (!container) return;
    container.innerHTML = html;
    container.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(old => {
      const script = document.createElement('script');
      if (old.src) script.src = old.src;
      if (old.textContent) script.textContent = old.textContent;
      document.head.appendChild(script);
      old.remove();
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('loadKalibracjaSection:', err);
    const container = document.getElementById('view-kalibracja-container');
    if (container) container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:24px;color:var(--hot);font-family:var(--mono);">Błąd ładowania sekcji kalibracji.</div>';
  }
}
loadKalibracjaSection();
</script>
'@; $newContent = @(); $newContent += $content[0..($start-1)]; $newContent += $placeholder; $newContent += $content[($end+1)..($content.Length-1)]; Set-Content $index $newContent -NoNewline; Write-Output 'Split complete';
```

### Opcje podziału od najbezpieczniejszej do najbardziej ryzykownej

#### Opcja 1 — Podział po stronie kompilacji, nie serwowania (NAJBEZPIECZNIEJSZA)

Pliki HTML, CSS i JS trzymasz osobno na swoim komputerze jako pliki deweloperskie. Przed wgraniem na ESP32 skrypt (Python lub Node) skleja je automatycznie w jeden plik i minifikuje. ESP32 nadal serwuje jeden plik.

Zysk: czytelność kodu podczas edycji, zero ryzyka dla działania urządzenia.

Narzędzie do tego to np. prosty skrypt Python który robi `string concatenation` albo bardziej zaawansowane jak Vite lub esbuild — ale bez frameworka, tylko jako bundler.

To jest podejście które polecam najbardziej dla Twojego przypadku.  Podejście hybrydowe: **podział deweloperski + jednoplikowy deployment**.

W praktyce wygląda to tak: na komputerze masz strukturę katalogów gdzie CSS jest w osobnym pliku, JavaScript podzielony na logiczne moduły (core.js, tray.js, heater.js, journal.js, kalibracja.js), a HTML ma miejsca oznaczone komentarzami gdzie wchodzą poszczególne sekcje.

Prosty skrypt build.py skleja wszystko w jeden `panel.html`, minifikuje (opcjonalnie) i to jest plik który wgrywasz na ESP32.

Dodatkowa zaleta tego podejścia: możesz otworzyć panel w przeglądarce bezpośrednio z dysku podczas developmentu, bez ESP32, i testować UI. Dopiero gdy chcesz przetestować komunikację z API, serwujesz z ESP32.

from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('firmware/data/index.html')
text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
# Count script tags
starts = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'<script[^>]*>', text)]
ends = [m.end() for m in re.finditer(r'</script>', text)]
print('script starts', len(starts), 'ends', len(ends))
for i,(s,e) in enumerate(zip(starts, ends),1):
    seg = text[s:e]
    preview = seg[:120].replace('\n',' ') + '...'
    print(i, 'start', s, 'end', e, preview)
# extract first and last script blocks

    # maybe more than 2 scripts

# locate <style>

# locate head/body boundary

body_start = text.find('<body>', head_end)

from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser

class MyParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.scripts=[]
        self.styles=[]
        self.current=None
        self.acc=[]
        self.script_attrs=None
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag=='script':
            self.current='script'
            self.acc=[]
            self.script_attrs=attrs
        elif tag=='style':
            self.current='style'
            self.acc=[]
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag=='script' and self.current=='script':
            self.scripts.append((''.join(self.acc), self.script_attrs))
            self.current=None
            self.acc=[]
        elif tag=='style' and self.current=='style':
            self.styles.append(''.join(self.acc))
            self.current=None
            self.acc=[]
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.current in ('script','style'):
            self.acc.append(data)

text=Path('firmware/data/index.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
parser=MyParser()
parser.feed(text)
print('num scripts', len(parser.scripts), 'num styles', len(parser.styles))

    print('script',i,'attrs',attrs,'len', len(content))
for i,content in enumerate(parser.styles,1):
    print('style',i,'len', len(content))

from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DATA = ROOT / 'firmware' / 'data'
DEV = DATA / 'dev'

INDEX = DATA / 'index.html'
KAL = DATA / 'kalibracja.html'
TEMPLATE = DEV / 'index.template.html'
STYLES = DEV / 'styles.css'
SCRIPT = DEV / 'app.js'
KAL_DEV = DEV / 'kalibracja.html'

STYLE_MARKER = '<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">'
SCRIPT_MARKER = '<script src="app.js"></script>'


def extract_dev_sources():
    DEV.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    text = INDEX.read_text(encoding='utf-8')

    style_match = re.search(r'<style>(.*?)</style>', text, flags=re.S)
    if not style_match:
        raise SystemExit('No <style>...</style> block found in index.html')
    style_content = style_match.group(1).strip()

    script_match = list(re.finditer(r'<script>(.*?)</script>', text, flags=re.S))
    if not script_match:
        raise SystemExit('No <script>...</script> block found in index.html')
    script_content = script_match[-1].group(1).strip()
    script_block = script_match[-1].group(0)

    template_text = text[:style_match.start()] + STYLE_MARKER + text[style_match.end():script_match[-1].start()] + SCRIPT_MARKER + text[script_match[-1].end():]
    template_text = template_text.replace('\r\n', '\n')

    TEMPLATE.write_text(template_text, encoding='utf-8')
    STYLES.write_text(style_content + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    SCRIPT.write_text(script_content + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    if KAL.exists():
        shutil.copy2(KAL, KAL_DEV)
    print(f'Extracted dev sources to {DEV}')
    print(f' - {TEMPLATE.name}')
    print(f' - {STYLES.name}')
    print(f' - {SCRIPT.name}')
    if KAL.exists():
        print(f' - {KAL_DEV.name}')


def build_deployed_index(minify=False):
    if not TEMPLATE.exists() or not STYLES.exists() or not SCRIPT.exists():
        raise SystemExit('Dev sources missing. Run with --extract first or create dev/index.template.html, dev/styles.css and dev/app.js')

    template_text = TEMPLATE.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    style_content = STYLES.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    script_content = SCRIPT.read_text(encoding='utf-8')

    if minify:
        style_content = minify_css(style_content)
        script_content = minify_js(script_content)

    deployed = template_text.replace(STYLE_MARKER, f'<style>\n{style_content}\n</style>')
    deployed = deployed.replace(SCRIPT_MARKER, f'<script>\n{script_content}\n</script>')
    INDEX.write_text(deployed, encoding='utf-8')
    print(f'Built deployed {INDEX}')
    if KAL_DEV.exists():
        shutil.copy2(KAL_DEV, KAL)
        print(f'Copied {KAL_DEV} -> {KAL}')


def minify_css(css: str) -> str:
    css = re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/', '', css, flags=re.S)
    css = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', css)
    css = re.sub(r'\s*([{}:;,])\s*', r'\1', css)
    return css.strip()


def minify_js(js: str) -> str:
    js = re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/', '', js, flags=re.S)
    js = re.sub(r'//[^\n]*', '', js)
    js = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', js)
    return js.strip()


def main():
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Build or extract WebUI assets for firmware/data')
    parser.add_argument('--extract', action='store_true', help='Extract dev sources from current firmware/data/index.html')
    parser.add_argument('--build', action='store_true', help='Build firmware/data/index.html from dev sources')
    parser.add_argument('--minify', action='store_true', help='Minify CSS and JS during build')
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not args.extract and not args.build:
        parser.print_help()
        raise SystemExit(1)

    if args.extract:
        extract_dev_sources()
    if args.build:
        build_deployed_index(minify=args.minify)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

function drawStatusOscillator(){
  const c=document.getElementById('pip-osc-temp');
  if(!c) return;
  const ctx=c.getContext('2d');
  const dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  const W=c.offsetWidth||320;
  const H=170;
  c.width=W*dpr;
  c.height=H*dpr;
  c.style.height=H+'px';
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

  const s=chartState.lastStatus||{};
  const tgt=isF(s.target_temp)?s.target_temp:null;
  const raw=historyStore.temp_chamber?.raw||[];
  const points=raw.slice(-24).map((item)=>({v:item.v,ts:item.ts}));
  const padding=26;
  const x0=padding;
  const x1=W-padding;
  const y0=padding;
  const y1=H-padding;
  const values=points.map((p)=>p.v).filter(isF);
  if(isF(s.temp_chamber)) values.push(s.temp_chamber);
  if(isF(tgt)) values.push(tgt-1, tgt+1);
  const minV=values.length?Math.min(...values):20;
  const maxV=values.length?Math.max(...values):42;
  const range=Math.max(0.5,maxV-minV);
  const mapX=(idx)=> x0 + (points.length>1 ? idx/(points.length-1) : 0.5) * (x1-x0);
  const mapY=(val)=> y1 - ((val-minV)/range) * (y1-y0);

  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.05)';
  ctx.fillRect(x0,y0,x1-x0,y1-y0);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.12)';
  ctx.lineWidth=1;
  ctx.strokeRect(x0,y0,x1-x0,y1-y0);

  if(isF(tgt)){
    const bandLow=Math.max(minV, tgt-0.5);
    const bandHigh=Math.min(maxV, tgt+0.5);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(34,197,94,.18)';
    ctx.fillRect(x0, mapY(bandHigh), x1-x0, mapY(bandLow)-mapY(bandHigh));
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.65)';
    ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x0, mapY(tgt));
    ctx.lineTo(x1, mapY(tgt));
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  if(points.length){
    ctx.strokeStyle='#111';
    ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    points.forEach((point,idx)=>{
      const px=mapX(idx);
      const py=mapY(point.v);
      if(idx===0) ctx.moveTo(px,py); else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
    });
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  if(isF(s.temp_chamber)){
    const cx=x1 - 10;
    const cy=mapY(s.temp_chamber);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx,cy,4,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.2)';
    ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.8)';
  ctx.font='600 12px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('Aktualna wartość: ' + (isF(s.temp_chamber)? s.temp_chamber.toFixed(1) + '°C' : '--'), x0, H - 8);
  ctx.fillText('Cel: ' + (isF(tgt)? tgt.toFixed(1) + '°C' : '--'), x0, H - 22);
}

 oldString:  updatePowerIndicators();
}

function readTrayControlInputs(i){
  const mainSpecies=document.getElementById('main-species-tray'+i);
  const statusSpecies=document.getElementById('status-species-tray'+i);
  const mainDay=document.getElementById('main-day-tray'+i);
  const statusDay=document.getElementById('status-day-tray'+i);
  const mainSpd=document.getElementById('main-spd-tray'+i);
  const statusSpd=document.getElementById('status-spd-tray'+i);
  const mainDur=document.getElementById('main-dur-tray'+i);
  const statusDur=document.getElementById('status-dur-tray'+i);
  const st=getTrayControlState(i);
  st.species = mainSpecies?.value ?? statusSpecies?.value ?? st.species ?? 'CHICKEN';
  const dayValue = mainDay?.value ?? statusDay?.value ?? String(st.day);
  const spdValue = mainSpd?.value ?? statusSpd?.value ?? String(st.spd);
  const durValue = mainDur?.value ?? statusDur?.value ?? String(st.dur);
  const day = Number.parseInt(dayValue, 10);
  const spd = Number.parseInt(spdValue, 10);
  const dur = Number.parseInt(durValue, 10);
  st.day = Number.isFinite(day) && day > 0 ? day : st.day;
  st.spd = Number.isFinite(spd) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(225, spd)) : st.spd;
  st.dur = Number.isFinite(dur) ? Math.max(500, dur) : st.dur;
  applyTrayControlState(i);
  return st;
}
function setTrayControlState(i,updates){ const st=getTrayControlState(i); Object.assign(st,updates); applyTrayControlState(i); return st; }
```

  if(!otherRows || !otherRows.length) return null;
  const other = otherRows.find((r)=>r.day===row.day);
  if(!other) return null;
  const tempOk = Math.max(row.temp_min, other.temp_min) <= Math.min(row.temp_max, other.temp_max);
  const humOk = Math.max(row.humidity_min, other.humidity_min) <= Math.min(row.humidity_max, other.humidity_max);
  if(tempOk && humOk) return {level:'green',text:'OK'};
  if(tempOk || humOk) return {level:'yellow',text:'Kompromis'};
  return {level:'red',text:'Konflikt'};
}

  const intervalTxt=(Number.isFinite(interval)&&interval>0)?(' co '+fmtTimeParts(interval,false).replace('0d ','')) : '';
  const turnTxtBase=Number.isFinite(rpd)?(rpd+'x/d'+intervalTxt):'--';
  const html=rows.map(row=>{
    const today=row.day===currentDay;
    const conflict=getScheduleConflict(row, otherRows);
    const cls=[today?'today':'', row.lockdown?'lockdown':'', conflict?`conflict-${conflict.level}`:''].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    const turnTxt=row.turn?('<span class="check">✓</span> '+turnTxtBase):'<span class="cross">—</span>';
    return `<tr class="${cls}"><td><span class="day-num ${today?'today-tag':''}">${today?'▶ ':''}${row.day}</span></td><td>${row.temp_min.toFixed(1)}–${row.temp_max.toFixed(1)}</td><td>${row.humidity_min}–${row.humidity_max}</td><td>${turnTxt}</td><td>${row.lockdown?'<span class="lock-badge">LOCK</span>':''}</td><td>${getConflictBadgeHtml(conflict)}</td><td style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">${row.notes||''}</td></tr>`;
  }).join('');
  mainBody.innerHTML=html;
  if(mainBadge) mainBadge.textContent=shortSpecies(species)+' · dzień '+currentDay+' · '+(Number.isFinite(rpd)?(rpd+'x/d'):'--');
}
async function loadSchedule(trayIdx){
  const spEl=document.getElementById('sched-species'+trayIdx);
  if(!spEl) return;
  const species=spEl.value;
  let rows=null;
  try{
    const data=await fetchJson('/api/schedule?species='+species,{},5000);
    if(data?.schedule?.length) rows=data.schedule;
  }catch(e){
    rows=null;
  }
  if(!rows){
    const sp=SPECIES[species]||SPECIES.CHICKEN;
    rows=[];
    for(let d=1; d<=sp.days; d++){
      const x=sp.rows(d);
      rows.push({
        day:d,
        temp_min:x.tmin,
        temp_max:x.tmax,
        humidity_min:x.hmin,
        humidity_max:x.hmax,
        turn:x.turn,
        lockdown:x.lockdown,
        notes:x.note
      });
    }
  }
  scheduleStore[trayIdx]=rows;
  renderScheduleTable(trayIdx);
  renderScheduleTable(1-trayIdx);
}

  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const hOn=!!state.power.heater[i];
    const hs=document.getElementById('sw-main-h'+i); if(hs) hs.checked=hOn;

    setDisabled('btn-main-h'+i+'-man',!hOn);
    setDisabled('btn-main-h'+i+'-auto',!hOn);
    updateHeaterIndicators(i,state.runtime.heaterPwm[i]||0);
  }
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const tOn=!!state.power.tray[i];

    const tps=document.getElementById('sw-pip-tray'+i); if(tps) tps.checked=tOn;

    setDisabled('main-dur-tray'+i,!tOn);

    setDisabled('status-day-tray'+i,!tOn);

    setDisabled('status-dur-tray'+i,!tOn);
    setDisabled('status-spd-tray'+i,!tOn);
    setDisabled('btn-status-move'+i,!tOn);
    setDisabled('btn-status-stop'+i,!tOn);
    setDisabled('btn-status-off'+i,!tOn);
    setDisabled('btn-status-on'+i,false);
    // Przełączniki tacy muszą pozostać klikalne także po OFF.

[map[filePath:j:\inkubator\firmware\data\dev\index.template.html newString:function updateTrayMotionStatus(i,tray){
  const motionEl=document.getElementById('status-tray'+i+'-motion');
  if(!motionEl) return;
  const localRemaining=Math.max(0,Math.floor(trayMotion[i].endTs-Date.now()));
  const apiRemaining=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(tray?.manual_move_remaining_ms)||0));
  const isApiMoving=!!tray?.moving||!!tray?.manual_move_active;
  const remaining=Math.max(localRemaining,apiRemaining);
  if(isApiMoving || remaining>0){
    const sec=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(remaining/1000));
    motionEl.innerHTML='<span class="motion-spin">↻</span> Ruch trwa · '+sec+' s';
    return;
  }
  motionEl.textContent='⏸ Bezczynna';
}
function updateTrayMainMoveMsg(i,tray){
  const st=document.getElementById('st-main-day'+i);
  if(!st) return;
  const localRemaining=Math.max(0,Math.floor(trayMotion[i].endTs-Date.now()));
  const apiRemaining=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(tray?.manual_move_remaining_ms)||0));
  const isApiMoving=!!tray?.moving||!!tray?.manual_move_active;
  const remaining=Math.max(localRemaining,apiRemaining);

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.stack=[]; self.records=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        self.stack.append((tag, dict(attrs)))
        if tag=='div' and any(v.startswith('display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr') for k,v in attrs if k=='style'):
            self.records.append(('ROW_START', len(self.stack), self.getpos(), attrs))
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if self.stack and self.stack[-1][0]==tag:
            self.stack.pop()
        else:
            self.records.append(('MISMATCH', tag, self.getpos()))
        if tag=='div' and len(self.stack)==0:
            self.records.append(('ROW_END', len(self.stack), self.getpos()))
P().feed(text); print('records:', self.records)"
```

class TagParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.stack=[]
        self.errors=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag not in ('br','img','input','meta','link','hr','area','base','col','embed','param','source','track','wbr'):
            self.stack.append((tag, self.getpos()))
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if not self.stack:
            self.errors.append(('unexpected closing', tag, self.getpos()))

            self.errors.append(('mismatch', last, tag, pos, self.getpos()))

      <div id="kal-pref-status" class="control-hint" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:10px">— gotowe —</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ─── Środek: Wizualizacja poziomnica + kąt ─── -->
  <div class="kal-card" style="text-align:center">
    <div class="kal-title">Poziomnica Tacy — Wizualizacja Kąta</div>
    <canvas id="kal-canvas" width="340" height="200" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"></canvas>
    <div class="kal-angle-info">
      Kąt: <span id="kal-angle-val" style="color:var(--accent);font-weight:500">0.0°</span>
      &nbsp;|&nbsp; Pozycja: <span id="kal-pos-label" style="color:var(--text)">POZIOM 0</span>
    </div>
    <div class="kal-pos-btns">
      <button class="kal-pos-btn" onclick="kalAnimateTo(-45,'MAX LEWO')">⟵ MAX L</button>
      <button class="kal-pos-btn" onclick="kalAnimateTo(-22,'PÓŁ LEWO')">← PÓŁ LEWO</button>
      <button class="kal-pos-btn" onclick="kalAnimateTo(0,'POZIOM 0')" style="border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)">■ 0°</button>
      <button class="kal-pos-btn" onclick="kalAnimateTo(22,'PÓŁ PRAWO')">PÓŁ P →</button>
      <button class="kal-pos-btn" onclick="kalAnimateTo(45,'MAX PRAWO')">MAX P ⟶</button>
    </div>
    <div style="margin-top:14px;padding:10px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;text-align:left">
      <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:6px">LEGENDA</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8">
        <span style="color:rgba(57,211,95,.6)">●</span> <strong style="color:var(--text)">Prostokąt</strong> = taca · kąt = przybliżony obrót<br>
        <span style="color:rgba(93,212,255,.8)">●</span> <strong style="color:var(--text)">Bąbel</strong> = wskaźnik poziomnicy (grawitacja)<br>
        <span style="color:rgba(245,166,35,.7)">—</span> linie przerywane = pozycje referencyjne (0°, ±45°)<br>
        Czas animacji ≈ proporcjonalny do 100% PWM
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ─── Prawa kolumna: Stoper ─── -->
  <div>
    <div class="kal-card">
      <div class="kal-title">Stoper</div>
      <div class="kal-clock" id="kal-clock-main">00:00.000</div>
      <div class="kal-clock-sub" id="kal-clock-sub">Łącznie: 00:00.000 · Okrążeń: 0</div>
      <div class="kal-btn-row" style="margin-bottom:8px">
        <button class="kal-btn kal-btn-start" id="kal-sw-start" onclick="kalSwStart()">▶ START</button>
        <button class="kal-btn kal-btn-stop" id="kal-sw-stop" onclick="kalSwStop()" disabled>■ STOP</button>
      </div>
      <div class="kal-btn-row">
        <button class="kal-btn kal-btn-lap" id="kal-sw-lap" onclick="kalSwLap()" disabled>⊙ LAP / ZAPISZ</button>
        <button class="kal-btn kal-btn-reset" onclick="kalSwReset()">↺ RESET</button>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top:10px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;background:var(--bg3)">
        <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px">Auto-LAP timeout</div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center">
          <input id="kal-auto-lap-sec" type="number" min="1" max="600" value="33" style="width:74px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);padding:4px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px">
          <button class="kal-btn kal-btn-reset" id="kal-auto-lap-btn" onclick="kalToggleAutoLap()" style="padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px">AUTO LAP: OFF</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="kal-laps" id="kal-laps-list">
        <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding:8px 0">Brak pomiarów</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="kal-card" style="margin-top:12px">
      <div class="kal-title">Skróty klawiszowe</div>
      <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);line-height:2;font-family:var(--mono)">
        <span style="color:var(--text);background:var(--bg3);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid var(--border)">SPACJA</span> Start / Stop<br>
        <span style="color:var(--text);background:var(--bg3);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid var(--border)">L</span> Lap / Zapisz<br>
        <span style="color:var(--text);background:var(--bg3);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid var(--border)">R</span> Reset stoper<br>
        <span style="color:var(--text);background:var(--bg3);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid var(--border)">0–9</span> Preset PWM<br>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div><!-- end kal-grid -->

<!-- ─── Tabela pomiarów + obliczenia ─── -->
<div class="kal-card" style="margin-top:14px">
  <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px">
    <div class="kal-title" style="margin-bottom:0">Wyniki Pomiarów</div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:6px">
      <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="font-size:11px" onclick="kalClearMeasurements()">↺ Wyczyść</button>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" style="font-size:11px" onclick="kalExportCSV()">↓ CSV</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="overflow-x:auto">
    <table class="kal-result-table" id="kal-meas-table">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>#</th>
          <th>Faza</th>
          <th>PWM%</th>
          <th>Czas (ms)</th>
          <th>Czas (s)</th>
          <th>Uwagi</th>
          <th></th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody id="kal-meas-body">
        <tr><td colspan="7" style="color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding:12px">Brak danych — naciśnij ⊙ LAP podczas pomiaru</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="kal-calc" id="kal-calc-box" style="display:none">
    <div class="kal-calc-title">Obliczenia i Porównanie</div>
    <div id="kal-calc-content"></div>
  </div>
</div>

</div><!-- end view-kalibracja -->

<script id="kal-script">
(function(){
/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
   KALIBRACJA TACY — logika JS
────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
const KAL = {
  pwm: 40,
  phase: '0→MAX_P',
  swRunning: false,
  swStart: 0,
  swElapsed: 0,
  swLapBase: 0,
  laps: [],       // {label, pwm, ms, ts}
  measurements: [],// same structure, all saved
  decayActive: false,
  decayStartTs: 0,
  decayStopTs: 0,
  decaySamples: [],
  decayTimer: null,
  angle: 0,
  targetAngle: 0,
  posLabel: 'POZIOM 0',
  animRaf: null,
  prefConfig: null,
  autoLapEnabled: false,
  autoLapTimer: null,
  seqCount: 10,
  seqRunning: false,
  seqTimer: null,
  seqStartTs: 0,
  seqDurationMs: 0,
};

/* ── formatters ── */
function fmtMs(ms){
  const m=Math.floor(ms/60000);
  const s=Math.floor((ms%60000)/1000);
  const mil=Math.floor(ms%1000);
  return String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(s).padStart(2,'0')+'.'+String(mil).padStart(3,'0');
}
function fmtMsShort(ms){
  return (ms/1000).toFixed(3)+'s';
}

function kalUpdateAutoLapButton(){
  const btn=document.getElementById('kal-auto-lap-btn');
  if(!btn) return;
  btn.textContent='AUTO LAP: '+(KAL.autoLapEnabled?'ON':'OFF');
  btn.classList.toggle('active',KAL.autoLapEnabled);
}
function kalScheduleAutoLap(){
  if(KAL.autoLapTimer){
    clearTimeout(KAL.autoLapTimer);
    KAL.autoLapTimer=null;
  }
  if(!KAL.autoLapEnabled || !KAL.swRunning) return;
  const secInput=document.getElementById('kal-auto-lap-sec');
  const sec=Math.max(1,Math.min(600,Number(secInput?.value)||33));
  KAL.autoLapTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
    if(KAL.swRunning) kalSwLap();
  },sec*1000);
}

window.kalToggleAutoLap=function(){
  KAL.autoLapEnabled=!KAL.autoLapEnabled;
  kalUpdateAutoLapButton();
  kalScheduleAutoLap();
};

window.kalSeqSetCount=function(n){
  KAL.seqCount=n;
  [1,3,5,10,20,50].forEach(v=>{
    const b=document.getElementById('kal-seq-c'+v);
    if(b) b.classList.toggle('active',v===n);
  });
  const runBtn=document.getElementById('kal-seq-run');
  if(runBtn) runBtn.textContent='▶ Uruchom '+n+'×';
  kalSeqUpdateTotal();
};

function kalSeqUpdateTotal(){
  const halfSec=Math.max(1,Number(document.getElementById('kal-seq-half-sec').value)||33);
  const total=halfSec*KAL.seqCount;
  const m=Math.floor(total/60);
  const s=Math.round(total%60);
  document.getElementById('kal-seq-total').textContent=total.toFixed(1)+'s = '+m+'m '+String(s).padStart(2,'0')+'s';
}

function kalSeqTick(){
  if(!KAL.seqRunning) return;
  const elapsed=Date.now()-KAL.seqStartTs;
  const remaining=Math.max(0,KAL.seqDurationMs-elapsed);
  const halfSec=Math.max(1,Number(document.getElementById('kal-seq-half-sec').value)||33);
  const halfMs=halfSec*1000;
  const currentHalf=Math.min(KAL.seqCount,Math.floor(elapsed/halfMs)+1);
  const progress=document.getElementById('kal-seq-progress');
  progress.textContent='▶ półcykl '+currentHalf+'/'+KAL.seqCount+' · pozostało '+Math.ceil(remaining/1000)+'s';
  if(remaining<=0){
    kalSeqStop(false,true);
  }
}

window.kalSeqRun=function(){
  if(KAL.seqRunning) return;
  const halfSec=Math.max(1,Number(document.getElementById('kal-seq-half-sec').value)||33);
  const durationMs=Math.round(halfSec*KAL.seqCount*1000);
  const tray=parseInt(document.getElementById('kal-tray-sel').value);
  const pwm=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round((KAL.pwm/100)*255)));
  const progress=document.getElementById('kal-seq-progress');
  KAL.seqRunning=true;
  KAL.seqDurationMs=durationMs;
  KAL.seqStartTs=Date.now();
  document.getElementById('kal-seq-run').disabled=true;
  document.getElementById('kal-seq-stop').disabled=false;
  progress.textContent='Wysyłam komendę...';
  fetchJson('/api/tray/move?tray='+tray+'&duration_ms='+durationMs+'&pwm_speed='+pwm,{method:'POST'},5000)
    .then(d=>{
      if(d&&d.ok){
        progress.textContent='▶ uruchomiono';
      }else{
        progress.textContent='⚠ API: '+((d&&d.error)?d.error:'błąd');
      }
      if(KAL.seqTimer){clearInterval(KAL.seqTimer);} 
      KAL.seqTimer=setInterval(kalSeqTick,500);
    })
    .catch(()=>{
      progress.textContent='⚠ offline — odliczanie lokalne';
      if(KAL.seqTimer){clearInterval(KAL.seqTimer);} 
      KAL.seqTimer=setInterval(kalSeqTick,500);
    });
};

window.kalSeqStop=function(manual,finished){
  if(!KAL.seqRunning && !finished) return;
  KAL.seqRunning=false;
  if(KAL.seqTimer){
    clearInterval(KAL.seqTimer);
    KAL.seqTimer=null;
  }
  document.getElementById('kal-seq-run').disabled=false;
  document.getElementById('kal-seq-stop').disabled=true;
  const progress=document.getElementById('kal-seq-progress');
  if(finished){
    progress.textContent='✓ zakończono '+KAL.seqCount+'× półcykli';
    return;
  }
  progress.textContent='■ zatrzymano';
  if(manual){
    const tray=parseInt(document.getElementById('kal-tray-sel').value);
    fetchJson('/api/tray/stop?tray='+tray,{method:'POST'},5000).catch(()=>{});
  }
};

/* ── Preferencje tac: import / edycja / zapis ── */
function kalSetPrefStatus(msg,err){
  const el=document.getElementById('kal-pref-status');
  if(!el) return;
  el.textContent=msg;
  el.style.color=err?'var(--hot)':'var(--muted)';
}
function kalFillPrefInputsFromTrays(trays){
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    const t=trays[i]||{};
    const active=!!t.active;
    const pwmRaw=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Number(t.rotation_pwm_speed ?? 102)));
    const durSec=Math.max(1,Math.round((Number(t.rotation_duration_ms)||15000)/1000));
    const intHours=(Number(t.rotation_interval_ms)||17280000)/3600000;
    const idx=i+1;
    const a=document.getElementById('kal-p'+idx+'-active');
    const p=document.getElementById('kal-p'+idx+'-pwm');
    const d=document.getElementById('kal-p'+idx+'-dur');
    const h=document.getElementById('kal-p'+idx+'-int');
    if(a) a.checked=active;
    if(p) p.value=String(pwmRaw);
    if(d) d.value=String(durSec);
    if(h) h.value=String(Math.max(0.1,Math.round(intHours*10)/10));
  }
}
function kalApplyTraysToConfig(cfg){
  if(!cfg.trays || !Array.isArray(cfg.trays)) cfg.trays=[];
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    if(!cfg.trays[i]) cfg.trays[i]={};
    const idx=i+1;
    const a=document.getElementById('kal-p'+idx+'-active');
    const p=document.getElementById('kal-p'+idx+'-pwm');
    const d=document.getElementById('kal-p'+idx+'-dur');
    const h=document.getElementById('kal-p'+idx+'-int');
    cfg.trays[i].active=!!(a&&a.checked);
    cfg.trays[i].rotation_pwm_speed=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Number(p?p.value:102)));
    cfg.trays[i].rotation_duration_ms=Math.max(1000,Math.round((Number(d?d.value:15)||15)*1000));
    cfg.trays[i].rotation_interval_ms=Math.max(60000,Math.round((Number(h?h.value:48)||48)*3600000));
  }
  return cfg;
}

window.kalPrefLoadFromApi=async function(){
  try{
    kalSetPrefStatus('Wczytywanie /api/config ...',false);
    const cfg=await fetchJson('/api/config');
    KAL.prefConfig=cfg;
    document.getElementById('kal-pref-json').value=JSON.stringify(cfg,null,2);
    kalFillPrefInputsFromTrays(cfg.trays||[]);
    kalSetPrefStatus('✓ Wczytano konfigurację z API',false);
  }catch(e){
    kalSetPrefStatus('⚠ Nie udało się wczytać /api/config',true);
  }
};

window.kalPrefApplyText=function(){
  try{
    const txt=document.getElementById('kal-pref-json').value.trim();
    if(!txt){kalSetPrefStatus('⚠ Pole JSON jest puste',true);return;}
    const parsed=JSON.parse(txt);
    const trays=Array.isArray(parsed.trays)?parsed.trays:(Array.isArray(parsed)?parsed:[]);
    if(!trays.length){kalSetPrefStatus('⚠ Brak trays[] w JSON',true);return;}
    KAL.prefConfig=parsed.trays?parsed:{trays:parsed};
    kalFillPrefInputsFromTrays(trays);
    kalSetPrefStatus('✓ Zastosowano dane z pola',false);
  }catch(e){
    kalSetPrefStatus('⚠ Nieprawidłowy JSON',true);
  }
};

window.kalPrefBuildText=function(){
  const base=(KAL.prefConfig&&typeof KAL.prefConfig==='object')?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(KAL.prefConfig)):{trays:[{},{},{}]};
  const cfg=kalApplyTraysToConfig(base);
  if(!cfg.tray_count) cfg.tray_count=2;
  KAL.prefConfig=cfg;
  document.getElementById('kal-pref-json').value=JSON.stringify(cfg,null,2);
  kalSetPrefStatus('✓ Zaktualizowano JSON z tabeli',false);
};

window.kalPrefSaveToApi=async function(){
  try{
    if(!KAL.prefConfig){
      const txt=document.getElementById('kal-pref-json').value.trim();
      if(txt) KAL.prefConfig=JSON.parse(txt);
      else KAL.prefConfig={trays:[{},{},{}],tray_count:2};
    }
    const cfg=kalApplyTraysToConfig(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(KAL.prefConfig)));
    if(!cfg.tray_count) cfg.tray_count=2;
    document.getElementById('kal-pref-json').value=JSON.stringify(cfg,null,2);
    kalSetPrefStatus('Zapisywanie do /api/config ...',false);
    const j=await fetchJson('/api/config',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(cfg)});
    if(j&&j.ok){
      KAL.prefConfig=cfg;
      kalSetPrefStatus('✓ Zapisano konfigurację tac',false);
    }else{
      kalSetPrefStatus('⚠ Błąd zapisu: '+(j.error||'nieznany'),true);
    }
  }catch(e){
    kalSetPrefStatus('⚠ Nie udało się zapisać /api/config',true);
  }
};

/* ── PWM ── */
window.kalPwmChange=function(v){
  KAL.pwm=+v;
  document.getElementById('kal-pwm-disp').textContent=v;
  document.querySelectorAll('.kal-preset').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',parseInt(b.textContent)===+v));
};
window.kalSetPwm=function(v){
  KAL.pwm=v;
  document.getElementById('kal-pwm-slider').value=v;
  document.getElementById('kal-pwm-disp').textContent=v;
  document.querySelectorAll('.kal-preset').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',parseInt(b.textContent)===v));
};

/* ── Phase ── */
window.kalSelectPhase=function(el,phase){
  KAL.phase=phase;
  document.querySelectorAll('.kal-phase-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('sel'));
  el.classList.add('sel');
};

/* ── Stopwatch ── */
let swTimer=null;
function swTick(){
  if(!KAL.swRunning) return;
  const now=performance.now();
  const total=KAL.swElapsed+(now-KAL.swStart);
  const lap=total-KAL.swLapBase;
  document.getElementById('kal-clock-main').textContent=fmtMs(lap);
  document.getElementById('kal-clock-sub').textContent=
    'Łącznie: '+fmtMs(total)+' · Okrążeń: '+KAL.laps.length;
  swTimer=requestAnimationFrame(swTick);
}
window.kalSwStart=function(){
  if(KAL.swRunning) return;
  KAL.swRunning=true;
  KAL.swStart=performance.now();
  document.getElementById('kal-sw-start').disabled=true;
  document.getElementById('kal-sw-stop').disabled=false;
  document.getElementById('kal-sw-lap').disabled=false;
  if(KAL.autoLapTimer){
    clearTimeout(KAL.autoLapTimer);
    KAL.autoLapTimer=null;
  }
  kalApiMove('right');
  kalScheduleAutoLap();
  swTick();
};
window.kalSwStop=function(){
  if(!KAL.swRunning) return;
  KAL.swElapsed+=(performance.now()-KAL.swStart);
  KAL.swRunning=false;
  if(swTimer){
    cancelAnimationFrame(swTimer);
    swTimer=null;
  }
  if(KAL.autoLapTimer){
    clearTimeout(KAL.autoLapTimer);
    KAL.autoLapTimer=null;
  }
  document.getElementById('kal-sw-start').disabled=false;
  document.getElementById('kal-sw-stop').disabled=true;
  kalSwLap();
  kalApiStop();
};
window.kalSwLap=function(){
  const now=performance.now();
  const total=KAL.swElapsed+(KAL.swRunning?(now-KAL.swStart):0);
  const lap=total-KAL.swLapBase;
  if(lap<10) return;
  const custom=document.getElementById('kal-phase-custom').value.trim();
  const label=custom||KAL.phase||'Pomiar';
  const entry={label,pwm:KAL.pwm,ms:Math.round(lap),ts:Date.now()};
  KAL.laps.push(entry);
  KAL.measurements.push({...entry});
  KAL.swLapBase=total;
  renderLaps();
  renderMeasurements();
  kalUpdateCalc();
  kalScheduleAutoLap();
  document.getElementById('kal-clock-main').textContent='00:00.000';
};
window.kalSwReset=function(){
  KAL.swRunning=false;
  if(swTimer){
    cancelAnimationFrame(swTimer);
    swTimer=null;
  }
  if(KAL.autoLapTimer){
    clearTimeout(KAL.autoLapTimer);
    KAL.autoLapTimer=null;
  }
  KAL.swElapsed=0;
  KAL.swStart=0;
  KAL.swLapBase=0;
  KAL.laps=[];
  document.getElementById('kal-clock-main').textContent='00:00.000';
  document.getElementById('kal-clock-sub').textContent='Łącznie: 00:00.000 · Okrążeń: 0';
  document.getElementById('kal-sw-start').disabled=false;
  document.getElementById('kal-sw-stop').disabled=true;
  document.getElementById('kal-sw-lap').disabled=true;
  renderLaps();
  renderMeasurements();
  kalUpdateCalc();
};

function renderLaps(){
  const el=document.getElementById('kal-laps-list');
  if(!KAL.laps.length){el.innerHTML='<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding:8px 0">Brak pomiarów</div>';return;}
  el.innerHTML=KAL.laps.map((l,i)=>
    `<div class="kal-lap-row">
       <span class="kal-lap-label">${i+1}. ${l.label}</span>
       <span class="kal-lap-pwm">${l.pwm}%</span>
       <span class="kal-lap-time">${fmtMs(l.ms)}</span>
     </div>`
  ).reverse().join('');
}

function renderMeasurements(){
  const body=document.getElementById('kal-meas-body');
  if(!KAL.measurements.length){
    body.innerHTML='<tr><td colspan="7" style="color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding:12px">Brak danych — naciśnij ⊙ LAP podczas pomiaru</td></tr>';
    return;
  }
  body.innerHTML=KAL.measurements.map((m,i)=>{
    const cls=m.pwm>=90?'hi':m.pwm>=60?'med':'lo';
    return `<tr>
      <td class="lo">${i+1}</td>
      <td style="color:var(--text)">${m.label}</td>
      <td class="${cls}">${m.pwm}%</td>
      <td class="hi">${m.ms.toLocaleString('pl')}</td>
      <td class="med">${(m.ms/1000).toFixed(3)}</td>
      <td class="lo" style="font-size:10px">${new Date(m.ts).toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL')}</td>
      <td><button class="del-btn" onclick="kalDelMeasurement(${i})">✕</button></td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join('');
}

window.kalDelMeasurement=function(i){
  KAL.measurements.splice(i,1);
  renderMeasurements();
  kalUpdateCalc();
};
window.kalClearMeasurements=function(){
  if(!KAL.measurements.length) return;
  if(!confirm('Wyczyścić wszystkie pomiary?')) return;
  KAL.measurements=[];
  renderMeasurements();
  document.getElementById('kal-calc-box').style.display='none';
};
window.kalOffAllStart=function(){
  if(KAL.decayActive) return;
  KAL.decayActive=true;
  KAL.decayStartTs=Date.now();
  KAL.decayStopTs=0;
  KAL.decaySamples=[];
  if(KAL.decayTimer){clearInterval(KAL.decayTimer);KAL.decayTimer=null;}
  const status=document.getElementById('kal-decay-status');
  if(status) status.textContent='⏳ OFF ALL rozpoczęty — zbieranie próbek temperatury i wilgotności.';
  const startBtn=document.getElementById('kal-offall-start');
  const stopBtn=document.getElementById('kal-offall-stop');
  const clearBtn=document.getElementById('kal-offall-clear');
  if(startBtn) startBtn.disabled=true;
  if(stopBtn) stopBtn.disabled=false;
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.disabled=true;
  if(window.globalPowerOff) globalPowerOff();
  KAL.decayTimer=setInterval(kalUpdateDecayStatus,1000);
  kalUpdateDecayStatus();
};
window.kalOffAllStop=function(){
  if(!KAL.decayActive) return;
  KAL.decayActive=false;
  KAL.decayStopTs=Date.now();
  if(KAL.decayTimer){clearInterval(KAL.decayTimer);KAL.decayTimer=null;}
  const status=document.getElementById('kal-decay-status');
  if(status) status.textContent='✓ Pomiar OFF ALL zatrzymany.';
  const startBtn=document.getElementById('kal-offall-start');
  const stopBtn=document.getElementById('kal-offall-stop');
  const clearBtn=document.getElementById('kal-offall-clear');
  if(startBtn) startBtn.disabled=false;
  if(stopBtn) stopBtn.disabled=true;
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.disabled=false;
  kalUpdateDecayCalculations();
};
window.kalClearDecay=function(){
  KAL.decayActive=false;
  if(KAL.decayTimer){clearInterval(KAL.decayTimer);KAL.decayTimer=null;}
  KAL.decaySamples=[];
  document.getElementById('kal-decay-status').textContent='✓ Stan OFF ALL wyczyszczony.';
  kalUpdateDecayCalculations();
};
function kalUpdateDecayStatus(){
  const duration=((KAL.decayActive?Date.now():KAL.decayStopTs)-KAL.decayStartTs)/1000;
  const status=document.getElementById('kal-decay-status');
  if(status) status.textContent='⏳ OFF ALL w toku: '+duration.toFixed(1)+'s';
  kalUpdateDecayCalculations();
}
function kalUpdateDecayCalculations(){
  const samples=KAL.decaySamples.length;
  const el=document.getElementById('kal-decay-box');
  if(el){
    el.style.display=samples?'' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('kal-decay-duration').textContent=samples?Math.round((Date.now()-KAL.decayStartTs)/1000)+' s':'0 s';
    document.getElementById('kal-decay-temp-rate').textContent='-- °C/h';
    document.getElementById('kal-decay-hum-rate').textContent='-- %/h';
    document.getElementById('kal-decay-samples').textContent=samples;
  }
}

async function loadKalibracjaSection(){
  try {
    const resp = await fetch('kalibracja.html');

    if (!container) return;
    container.innerHTML = html;
    container.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(old => {
      const script = document.createElement('script');
      if (old.src) script.src = old.src;
      if (old.textContent) script.textContent = old.textContent;
      document.head.appendChild(script);
      old.remove();
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('loadKalibracjaSection:', err);
    const container = document.getElementById('view-kalibracja-container');
    if (container) container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:24px;color:var(--hot);font-family:var(--mono);">Bd adowania sekcji kalibracji.</div>';
  }
}

  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--fg3);
  min-height: 14px;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
  transition: color .3s;
}

.status-msg.ok  { color: var(--acc); }
.status-msg.err { color: var(--red); }

/* ─── ANIMATIONS ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@keyframes conv {
  to { stroke-dashoffset: -20; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mini-scale-pin { transition: none; }
  * { animation: none !important; }
}

/* ─── RESPONSIVE ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .gauge-row       { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .heater-grid     { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .delta-row       { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .bottom-grid     { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .trays-grid      { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="view" id="view-status">

  <!-- HEADER -->

    <div class="pip-logo">HATCH OPS // TACTICAL INCUBATION CONTROL</div>

  <!-- GAUGES -->

    <div class="gauge-card">

    <div class="gauge-card">
      <canvas id="pip-esp" class="pip-canvas" width="80" height="80"></canvas>

  <!-- HEATERS -->

      <div class="vu-wrap">

<script>
/* ─────────────── CANVAS: GAUGE ────────────────────────────── */
function drawGauge(id, pct, color, bg) {
  const c = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!c) return;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  const W = c.width, H = c.height;
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2 + 4;
  const r = Math.min(W, H) / 2 - 8;
  const lw = 5;
  const startA = Math.PI * 0.75;
  const endA   = Math.PI * 2.25;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, startA, endA);
  ctx.strokeStyle = bg || 'rgba(57,211,95,.1)';
  ctx.lineWidth = lw;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.stroke();
  const fillEnd = startA + (endA - startA) * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, pct));
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, startA, fillEnd);
  ctx.strokeStyle = color || '#39d35f';
  ctx.lineWidth = lw;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.stroke();
  const tickR = r - lw - 2;
  for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
    const a = startA + (endA - startA) * (i / 10);
    const x1 = cx + Math.cos(a) * (tickR - 3);
    const y1 = cy + Math.sin(a) * (tickR - 3);
    const x2 = cx + Math.cos(a) * (tickR + (i % 5 === 0 ? 6 : 3));
    const y2 = cy + Math.sin(a) * (tickR + (i % 5 === 0 ? 6 : 3));
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = i % 5 === 0 ? 'rgba(57,211,95,.5)' : 'rgba(57,211,95,.2)';
    ctx.lineWidth = i % 5 === 0 ? 1.5 : .8;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

/* ─────────────── CANVAS: RING ─────────────────────────────── */
function drawRing(id, pct, inactive) {
  const c = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!c) return;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  const W = c.width, H = c.height;
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
  const r = Math.min(W, H) / 2 - 8;
  const lw = 7;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(57,211,95,.1)';
  ctx.lineWidth = lw;
  ctx.stroke();
  if (!inactive && pct > 0) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI * 2 * pct);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#39d35f';
    ctx.lineWidth = lw;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = inactive ? 'rgba(57,211,95,.2)' : 'rgba(184,245,200,.85)';
  ctx.font = `600 ${inactive ? 11 : 14}px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText(inactive ? 'OFF' : Math.round(pct * 100) + '%', cx, cy);
}

/* ─────────────── CANVAS: OSCILLOSCOPE ─────────────────────── */
const OSC_HISTORY = [];
const OSC_W = 640;
const OSC_TARGET = 37.8;
const OSC_RANGE  = 0.5;
const OSC_MIN    = 36.4;
const OSC_MAX    = 39.2;

function initOsc() {
  for (let i = 0; i < OSC_W; i++) {
    OSC_HISTORY.push(OSC_TARGET + Math.sin(i * 0.09) * 0.28 + Math.sin(i * 0.035) * 0.12);
  }
}

function drawOsc() {
  const c = document.getElementById('pip-osc-temp');
  if (!c) return;
  c.width = c.offsetWidth || OSC_W;
  const W = c.width, H = c.height;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  function ty(v) { return H - (v - OSC_MIN) / (OSC_MAX - OSC_MIN) * H; }

  const tyHi = ty(OSC_TARGET + OSC_RANGE);
  const tyLo = ty(OSC_TARGET - OSC_RANGE);
  const tyT  = ty(OSC_TARGET);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(57,211,95,.07)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, tyHi, W, tyLo - tyHi);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.setLineDash([4, 5]);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(57,211,95,.22)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, tyT); ctx.lineTo(W, tyT);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  const step = W / OSC_HISTORY.length;
  ctx.beginPath();
  OSC_HISTORY.forEach((v, i) => {
    const x = i * step, y = ty(v);
    i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  });
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(57,211,95,.8)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(57,211,95,.6)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc((OSC_HISTORY.length - 1) * step, ty(OSC_HISTORY[OSC_HISTORY.length - 1]), 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function tickOsc(newVal) {
  OSC_HISTORY.push(newVal !== undefined ? newVal : OSC_TARGET + (Math.random() - .5) * .4);
  if (OSC_HISTORY.length > OSC_W) OSC_HISTORY.shift();
  drawOsc();
}

/* ─────────────── HEATER CONTROLS ──────────────────────────── */
function updHeater(ch, v) {
  v = parseInt(v);
  const pct = Math.round(v / 225 * 100);
  document.getElementById('vu-fill' + ch).style.width = pct + '%';
  document.getElementById('vu-val' + ch).textContent = v;
  document.getElementById('sv-heater' + ch).textContent = v;
  document.getElementById('led-heater' + ch).classList.toggle('on', v > 0);
}

function setHeaterMode(ch, mode) {
  const tag = document.getElementById('mode-heater' + ch);
  tag.textContent = mode === 'auto' ? 'AUTO' : 'MAN';
  tag.className = 'mode-tag ' + (mode === 'auto' ? 'auto' : 'man');
}

function toggleHeaterPower(ch, on) {}
function setHeaterManual(ch) { setHeaterMode(ch, 'man'); }
function setHeaterAuto(ch)   { setHeaterMode(ch, 'auto'); }

/* ─────────────── TRAY CONTROLS ────────────────────────────── */
function toggleTrayPower(idx, on) {
  const card = document.querySelectorAll('.tray-card')[idx];
  if (card) card.classList.toggle('inactive', !on);
}

function syncStatusSpecies(idx) {}
function setTrayDayStatus(idx) {}
function moveTrayStatus(idx) {}
function stopTray(idx) {}
function toggleDiffuserPower(idx, on) {
  const dot = document.getElementById('dot-diff' + idx);
  if (dot) dot.classList.toggle('on', on);
}
function showTab(name) {}

/* ─────────────── CLOCK ─────────────────────────────────────── */
function updClock() {
  const d = new Date();
  const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  const el = document.getElementById('clock');
  if (el) el.textContent = `${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}:${pad(d.getSeconds())}`;
}

/* ─────────────── INIT ──────────────────────────────────────── */
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  drawGauge('pip-chamber', 0.78, '#39d35f');
  drawGauge('pip-hum',     0.58, '#5baee8');
  drawGauge('pip-ds18',    0.77, '#39d35f');
  drawGauge('pip-esp',     0.42, '#f5a623');
  drawRing('pip-tray0', 0.43, false);
  drawRing('pip-tray1', 0,    true);
  initOsc();
  drawOsc();
  updClock();
  setInterval(updClock, 1000);
  setInterval(tickOsc, 2000);
  window.addEventListener('resize', drawOsc);
});
</script>
</body>

        self.stack=[]

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in ('area','base','br','col','embed','hr','img','input','link','meta','param','source','track','wbr'): return
        self.stack.append(tag)
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in ('area','base','br','col','embed','hr','img','input','link','meta','param','source','track','wbr'): return

            # auto-close intermediate tags

                self.errors.append(f'Missing </{self.stack[-1]}> before </{tag}>')
                self.stack.pop()
            if self.stack and self.stack[-1] == tag:
                self.stack.pop()
        else:
            self.errors.append(f'Unmatched </{tag}>')

Umieść go np. **przed** sekcją `` (oscylatorem), ale może być też w dowolnym miejscu w obrębie `view-status`.

### 3. Na samym końcu pliku, przed zamykającym `` (lub przed ``), dodaj następujący kod JavaScript:
javascript

```
// Obsługa nowych suwaków PWM (grzałki CH0 i CH1)
(function initHeaterSliders() {
  for (let ch of [0, 1]) {
    const slider = document.getElementById(`slider-heater${ch}`);
    const valSpan = document.getElementById(`val-heater${ch}`);
    const manBtn = document.getElementById(`btn-heater${ch}-man`);
    const autoBtn = document.getElementById(`btn-heater${ch}-auto`);
    const modeSpan = document.getElementById(`mode-heater${ch}`);
    const ledSpan = document.getElementById(`led-heater${ch}`);
    if (!slider) continue;

    // Wyświetlanie wartości
    slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
      valSpan.textContent = slider.value;
    });

    // Ręczny – ustaw wartość w oryginalnym suwaku i wywołaj istniejącą funkcję
    manBtn.onclick = () => {
      const pwm = parseInt(slider.value);
      if (isNaN(pwm)) return;
      const origSlider = document.getElementById(`sl-h${ch}`) || document.getElementById(`sl-main-h${ch}`);
      if (origSlider) origSlider.value = pwm;
      // Wywołaj globalną funkcję setHeaterManual (istnieje w oryginalnym kodzie)
      if (typeof setHeaterManual === 'function') setHeaterManual(ch);
      else console.warn('setHeaterManual nie zdefiniowane');
    };

    // Automat
    autoBtn.onclick = () => {
      if (typeof setHeaterAuto === 'function') setHeaterAuto(ch);
      else console.warn('setHeaterAuto nie zdefiniowane');
    };

    // Cykliczne odświeżanie stanu (tryb, PWM, dioda)
    setInterval(() => {
      if (typeof state !== 'undefined' && state.runtime) {
        const manual = state.runtime.heaterManual[ch];
        modeSpan.textContent = manual ? 'RĘCZNY' : 'AUTO';
        modeSpan.className = `mode-pill ${manual ? 'manual' : 'auto'}`;
        const pwm = state.runtime.heaterPwm[ch] || 0;
        if (!manual && slider.value != pwm) slider.value = pwm;
        valSpan.textContent = slider.value;
        const isActive = state.power.heater[ch] && pwm > 5;
        ledSpan.className = `device-dot ${isActive ? 'on' : 'off'}`;
      }
    }, 1000);
  }
})();
```

### 4. Dodaj też w `` (jeśli nie ma) definicję dla `.device-dot.on` i `.device-dot.off` – ale w Twoim oryginalnym kodzie już one są, więc nie trzeba.

## Dlaczego to zadziała?

- Nie usuwasz żadnych istniejących elementów ani funkcji.
- Wykorzystujesz oryginalne, sprawdzone funkcje `setHeaterManual(ch)` i `setHeaterAuto(ch)`, które już działają (są w Twoim kodzie).
- Nowe suwaki są niezależne – jedynie na żądanie "ręczne" ustawiają wartość w oryginalnym suwaku (`sl-h0` itp.) i wywołują tę samą funkcję, którą i tak używasz.
- Dioda LED i znacznik trybu są aktualizowane na bieżąco na podstawie globalnego obiektu `state` (który jest aktualizowany przez `updateAll`).

from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser

for rel in ['index.html', 'firmware/data/index.html']:
    text = Path(rel).read_text('utf-8', errors='replace')
    class TagCounter(HTMLParser):
        def __init__(self):
            super().__init__()
            self.stack = []
            self.errors = []
        def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
            if tag in ('area','base','br','col','embed','hr','img','input','link','meta','param','source','track','wbr'): return
            self.stack.append((tag, self.getpos()))
        def handle_endtag(self, tag):
            if tag in ('area','base','br','col','embed','hr','img','input','link','meta','param','source','track','wbr'): return
            if not self.stack:
                self.errors.append(('unmatched', tag, self.getpos())); return
            if self.stack[-1][0] == tag:
                self.stack.pop(); return
            for i in range(len(self.stack)-2,-1,-1):
                if self.stack[i][0]==tag:
                    while len(self.stack)-1>i:
                        self.errors.append(('missing_close', self.stack[-1][0], self.getpos())); self.stack.pop()
                    self.stack.pop(); return
            self.errors.append(('unmatched', tag, self.getpos()))
    parser = TagCounter(); parser.feed(text)
    print(rel)
    print('remaining stack', len(parser.stack), parser.stack[-10:])
    print('errors', parser.errors[:20])
    print('---')

```

  <div class="page">

    </div>

      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Temperatura komory</div>
        <div class="metric-big" id="disp-temp">--°C</div>
        <div class="metric-sub">Zadana temperatura: <span id="disp-target">37.8°C</span></div>
        <div class="bar"><div class="bar-fill" id="temp-bar" style="width:0%"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Wyjście rozmyte</div>
        <div class="metric-big" id="disp-fuzzy">0%</div>
        <div class="metric-sub">sterowanie mocą grzałek</div>
        <div class="bar"><div class="bar-fill" id="fuzzy-bar" style="width:0%"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Aktualne nastawy</div>
        <div class="label-grid"><span>Błąd</span><strong id="disp-error">--°C</strong></div>
        <div class="label-grid"><span>d(e)/dt</span><strong id="disp-deriv">--</strong></div>
        <div class="label-grid"><span>Tryb</span><strong id="disp-mode">AUTO</strong></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid grid-2" style="margin-top:18px;">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Fuzzy Logic (eFLL style)</div>
        <p class="metric-sub">Model używa 5 trójkątnych funkcji przynależności dla błędu (e) i zmiany błędu (de). Wynik defuzyfikowany jest metodą centroidu.</p>
        <div class="log" id="fuzzy-log"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Kontrola grzałek</div>
        <div class="control-row">
          <label>CH0 PWM <span id="disp-ch0">0</span></label>
          <input type="range" min="0" max="225" value="0" id="slider-ch0">
        </div>
        <div class="control-row">
          <label>CH1 PWM <span id="disp-ch1">0</span></label>
          <input type="range" min="0" max="225" value="0" id="slider-ch1">
        </div>
        <div class="btn-group">
          <button id="btn-manual">Ręczny tryb</button>
          <button id="btn-auto">AUTO fuzzy</button>
        </div>
        <div class="footer-note">W trybie AUTO suwaki służą tylko podglądowi działania regulatora.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const state = {
      temp: 37.0,
      target: 37.8,
      lastTemp: 37.0,
      mode: 'AUTO',
      fuzzyOutput: 0,
      pwm0: 0,
      pwm1: 0,
      manualOverride: false,
      fuzzyRules: []
    };

    const membershipSets = {
      NB: x => trapezoid(x, -10, -10, -4, -2),
      NS: x => triangle(x, -4, -2, 0),
      ZE: x => triangle(x, -1, 0, 1),
      PS: x => triangle(x, 0, 2, 4),
      PB: x => trapezoid(x, 2, 4, 10, 10)
    };

    const fuzzyLabels = ['NB','NS','ZE','PS','PB'];

    function triangle(x, a, b, c) {
      if (x <= a || x >= c) return 0;
      if (x <= b) return (x - a) / (b - a);
      return (c - x) / (c - b);
    }
    function trapezoid(x, a, b, c, d) {
      if (x <= a || x >= d) return 0;
      if (x <= b) return (x - a) / (b - a);
      if (x >= c) return (d - x) / (d - c);
      return 1;
    }

    function buildFuzzyRules() {
      const matrix = {
        NB: { NB: PB, NS: PB, ZE: PS, PS: ZE, PB: ZE },
        NS: { NB: PB, NS: PS, ZE: PS, PS: ZE, PB: NS },
        ZE: { NB: PS, NS: PS, ZE: ZE, PS: NS, PB: NS },
        PS: { NB: PS, NS: ZE, ZE: NS, PS: NB, PB: NB },
        PB: { NB: ZE, NS: NS, ZE: NS, PS: NB, PB: NB }
      };
      for (const e of fuzzyLabels) {
        for (const de of fuzzyLabels) {
          state.fuzzyRules.push({ e, de, out: matrix[e][de] });
        }
      }
    }

    function fuzzify(value) {
      const out = {};
      for (const label of fuzzyLabels) {
        out[label] = membershipSets[label](value);
      }
      return out;
    }

    function defuzzify(outputActivations) {
      const weights = { NB: 0, NS: 25, ZE: 50, PS: 75, PB: 100 };
      let numerator = 0, denominator = 0;
      for (const label of fuzzyLabels) {
        const alpha = outputActivations[label] || 0;
        numerator += alpha * weights[label];
        denominator += alpha;
      }
      return denominator ? numerator / denominator : 0;
    }

    function evaluateFuzzy(error, derivative) {
      const eFuzzy = fuzzify(error);
      const deFuzzy = fuzzify(derivative);
      const aggregated = { NB:0, NS:0, ZE:0, PS:0, PB:0 };
      const activations = [];
      for (const rule of state.fuzzyRules) {
        const alpha = Math.min(eFuzzy[rule.e], deFuzzy[rule.de]);
        if (alpha > 0) {
          aggregated[rule.out] = Math.max(aggregated[rule.out], alpha);
          activations.push(`${rule.e}/${rule.de}→${rule.out} (${alpha.toFixed(2)})`);
        }
      }
      updateLog(activations.slice(-6));
      return defuzzify(aggregated);
    }

    function updateState() {
      const error = state.target - state.temp;
      const derivative = state.temp - state.lastTemp;
      state.lastTemp = state.temp;
      const fuzzyOutput = evaluateFuzzy(error, derivative);
      state.fuzzyOutput = fuzzyOutput;
      const pwm = Math.round(fuzzyOutput * 2.25);
      if (!state.manualOverride) {
        state.pwm0 = Math.min(225, pwm);
        state.pwm1 = Math.min(225, Math.round(pwm * 0.55));
      }
      renderDisplay(error, derivative);
    }

    function renderDisplay(error, derivative) {
      document.getElementById('disp-temp').textContent = state.temp.toFixed(1) + '°C';
      document.getElementById('disp-target').textContent = state.target.toFixed(1) + '°C';
      document.getElementById('disp-error').textContent = error.toFixed(2) + '°C';
      document.getElementById('disp-deriv').textContent = derivative.toFixed(3) + '°C/s';
      document.getElementById('disp-fuzzy').textContent = state.fuzzyOutput.toFixed(0) + '%';
      document.getElementById('temp-bar').style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (state.temp - 30)*10)) + '%';
      document.getElementById('fuzzy-bar').style.width = state.fuzzyOutput.toFixed(0) + '%';
      document.getElementById('disp-ch0').textContent = state.pwm0;
      document.getElementById('disp-ch1').textContent = state.pwm1;
      document.getElementById('slider-ch0').value = state.pwm0;
      document.getElementById('slider-ch1').value = state.pwm1;
      document.getElementById('status-mode').textContent = state.manualOverride ? 'MANUAL' : 'AUTO (Fuzzy)';
      document.getElementById('disp-mode').textContent = state.manualOverride ? 'MANUAL' : 'AUTO';
    }

    function updateLog(entries) {
      const log = document.getElementById('fuzzy-log');
      const now = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL');
      log.innerHTML = entries.map(line => `<p>${now} • ${line}</p>`).join('') + log.innerHTML;
      while (log.children.length > 8) log.removeChild(log.lastChild);
    }

    function setManualMode(enable) {
      state.manualOverride = enable;
      document.getElementById('status-mode').textContent = enable ? 'MANUAL' : 'AUTO (Fuzzy)';
      document.getElementById('disp-mode').textContent = enable ? 'MANUAL' : 'AUTO';
    }

    function simulateHeat() {
      const ambient = 22.5;
      const power = (state.pwm0 + state.pwm1) / 450;
      state.temp += (power * 0.18) - (state.temp - ambient) * 0.03;
      state.temp = Math.max(ambient, state.temp);
      renderDisplay(state.target - state.temp, state.temp - state.lastTemp);
    }

    document.getElementById('slider-ch0').addEventListener('input', e => {
      state.pwm0 = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
      document.getElementById('disp-ch0').textContent = state.pwm0;
    });
    document.getElementById('slider-ch1').addEventListener('input', e => {
      state.pwm1 = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
      document.getElementById('disp-ch1').textContent = state.pwm1;
    });
    document.getElementById('btn-manual').addEventListener('click', () => setManualMode(true));
    document.getElementById('btn-auto').addEventListener('click', () => setManualMode(false));

    buildFuzzyRules();
    setInterval(() => {
      if (!state.manualOverride) updateState();
      simulateHeat();
    }, 2000);
    setInterval(simulateHeat, 1000);
    renderDisplay(0,0);
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    function toggleTrayPower(index, isOn) {
      const checkbox = document.getElementById(`sw-pip-tray${index}`);
      if (checkbox) checkbox.checked = isOn;
      const indicator = document.getElementById(`ind-status-tray${index}`);
      if (indicator) indicator.classList.toggle('on', isOn);
    }

    function syncStatusSpecies(index) {
      const select = document.getElementById(`status-species-tray${index}`);
      const badge = document.getElementById(`badge-status-tray${index}-species`);
      if (select && badge) badge.textContent = select.selectedOptions[0]?.textContent || '--';
    }

    function setTrayDayStatus(index) {
      console.log('setTrayDayStatus', index, document.getElementById(`status-day-tray${index}`)?.value);
    }

    function moveTrayStatus(index) {
      console.log('moveTrayStatus', index);
      const motion = document.getElementById(`status-tray${index}-motion`);
      if (motion) motion.textContent = '▶ Praca';
    }

    function stopTray(index) {
      console.log('stopTray', index);
      const motion = document.getElementById(`status-tray${index}-motion`);
      if (motion) motion.textContent = '■ Zatrzymana';
    }

    function setHeaterManual(index) {
      console.log('setHeaterManual', index);
      const pill = document.getElementById(`pill-h${index}`);
      if (pill) {
        pill.textContent = 'MANUAL';
        pill.classList.remove('auto');
      }
    }

    function setHeaterAuto(index) {
      console.log('setHeaterAuto', index);
      const pill = document.getElementById(`pill-h${index}`);
      if (pill) {
        pill.textContent = 'AUTO';
        pill.classList.add('auto');
      }
    }

    function toggleHeaterPower(index, isOn) {
      const dot = document.getElementById(`dot-h${index}`);
      if (dot) dot.classList.toggle('on', isOn);
    }

      const dot = document.getElementById(`dot-diff${index}`);
